name: Alldigi Tech Ltd
title: Alldigi Tech Ltd - 532633 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Alldigi is an HR/payroll and BPM outsourcer, not a capacity-driven business: FY26 revenue +9.6% to INR598.7 Cr, EBITDA margin 27.1%, with BPM headcount falling as management exits low-margin work and no capex expansion signalled.

capex.quote: our admin and facility capex is typically in the range of INR 20 crores to INR25 crores for a year

triggers.label: BPM headcount declines on purpose
triggers.quote: this is a strategic move that we've done of moving away from some of our low-margin business

triggers.label: Existing-client headcount plateaued
triggers.quote: our existing customers have more or less plateaued

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth mid-teens
triggers.quote: we should see the mid-teen growth for this year as well in terms of revenue

triggers.label: RCM BPM headcount doubled
triggers.quote: we have doubled in terms of FTE

guidance.quote: we should see the mid-teen growth for this year as well in terms of revenue
We should look at about 1% to 2% improvement for FY '27 as well.

guidance.value: INR20-25 Cr per year admin and facility; Chennai office ~INR20 Cr
guidance.quote: that will, of course, lead to some investments to the tune of INR20 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: we typically target 1% to 1.5% kind of margin growth year-on-year basis

red_flags.label: BPM growth stalled, no large client win in ~12 months
red_flags.quote: That is something that is missing in the last about 12 months in terms of 1 large -- 1 or 2 large clients getting onboarded.

red_flags.label: Currency tailwind inflating growth
red_flags.quote: Yes. So 3 .3% is the growth attributable to the currency depreciation and 6.3% is the growth attributable to the various efforts

evasions.quote: we cannot give you a ballpark number

evasions.topic: Timing of next large BPM client win
evasions.quote: I'm not giving you a time line
nothing that I'll be able to openly disclose now
